mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.schedule_id, a.department, a.date, a.time, a.doctor_name, a.status, a.cancel_reason FROM appointment a INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id WHERE d.user_id = #{doctorUserId} AND a.status = #{status} ORDER BY a.date DESC, a.time ASC, a.id DESC
